property_summary: For all callers that are not the contract owner, calling withdrawFees(asset, recipient) on the reference contract always reverts; the mutant (which removes onlyOwner) allows some non-owner caller to successfully call withdrawFees and transfer out fees, breaking this invariant.
change_summary: Change the onlyOwner modifier on withdrawFees to no modifier (removes ownership check) so withdrawFees can be called by anyone, altering whether it reverts on unauthorized callers.
